name: TikTok Ads Performance Reporter with AI Analysis

parameters.content: # TikTok Ads Performance Reporter with AI Analysis

options.systemMessage:
You are an expert senior paid-media analyst. Your task is to analyze the provided TikTok Ads performance metrics and generate a highly strategic, data-driven report. 

Carefully evaluate the weekly trends (spend, efficiency, volume), identify top-performing campaigns (high CTR/ROAS/Conversions) and underperforming campaigns (high CPA, low CTR, or budget bleed) with precise, metric-backed reasons. Provide sharp, actionable optimization recommendations.

CRITICAL: You must output your analysis strictly adhering to the structure defined by the connected Output Parser. Do not include any conversational filler, markdown formatting wrappers (like ```json), or extra text. Return ONLY the raw JSON object.

nodes.notes: access_token removed from here on purpose. It now lives in the 'TikTok API Credential' HTTP Header Auth credential attached to the Fetch TikTok Campaign Report node, not in plain workflow data.

nodes.name: Fetch TikTok Campaign Report
nodes.notes: Create an HTTP Header Auth credential in n8n: Name='Access-Token', Value=<your TikTok access token>. This keeps the token out of the JSON/expressions entirely.

parameters.content:
# Overview
When schedule triggers at 9am weekdays, this workflow creates TikTok Ads report:

1. Load client config and compute date range
2. Fetch TikTok campaign data via API and mock code
3. Validate response and aggregate metrics
4. Check data completeness and alert if empty
5. Init agent loop and run AI analysis with structured parser
6. Handle AI errors with retry, backoff and max check
7. Format Slack and email reports with $ metrics
8. Send Slack report, log success, and handle failures via Slack Gmail and Sheets

# Node-by-node Purpose

1. Note Title
Canvas title sticky for organization

2. Schedule Trigger1
Runs at 9am Mon to Fri via cron

3. IF Data Complete1
Checks total spend and campaign count greater than zero

4. Slack Incomplete Data Alert1
Sends warning for empty data to Slack channel

5. AI Agent Analyze Performance1
Analyzes metrics with system prompt for strategic report

6. Build Error Message1
Builds error object from execution context

7. Slack Error Alert1
Posts workflow failure details to Slack

8. Gmail Error Alert1
Sends failure email to ops address

9. Structured Output Parser1
Enforces JSON schema for AI output

10. Set Init Agent Loop
Sets iteration zero max three and carries metrics

11. IF Agent Error
Checks if AI output has error field

12. Set Increment Iteration
Adds one to iteration counter

13. IF Max Iterations Reached
Checks iteration greater or equal to max

14. Set Error Agent Failure
Creates final failure payload after retries

15. Wait Backoff
Waits exponential time 3 power iteration times 10

16. Google Sheets Log Error
Appends error to error logs sheet

17. Error Trigger
Starts error flow on any workflow error

18. Set Client Config
Defines client name advertiser id period and channels

19. Compute Date Range
Calculates start and end ISO dates from period days

20. IF API Success
Checks code zero and list length greater than zero

21. Mistral Cloud Chat Model
Provides Mistral model to AI Agent

22. Fetch TikTok Campaign Report
Calls TikTok business API with auth header

23. Fetch TikTok Campaign Report Code
Returns 3-campaign structured JSON object for testing (Fixed Object-return error)

24. Slack API Failure Alert
Sends API error alert to Slack channel #all-first (C0B49NSVBRC)

25. Parse and Extract Metrics
Aggregates totals and computes CTR CPC ROAS

26. Workflow Success Log
Prepares success metadata

27. Send Slack Report
Sends formatted Slack message

28. Format Final Report
Builds Slack blocks and HTML email with $ amounts

29. Google Sheets Log Success
Appends actual campaign performance data (spend, clicks, impressions) to success log sheet

30. Google Gemini Chat Model
Provides Gemini model to AI Agent
